title: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.31539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. translated_title: 无需真值标签的智能体评估：零假设比例视角
translated_abstract: 智能体所采取行动的正确性通常依据已知的、经外部验证的真值标签来评估，例如证明是否正确，或代码能否编译并通过单元测试。然而，随着编程和科学智能体被赋予更多端到端的自主权——提出干预方案、开展实验、决定接下来部署和研究什么——智能体的行动是否真正改善了结果，必须从充满噪声且常常没有定论的实验中推断出来。为了在这一设定下评估智能体，我们将智能体质量定义为其轨迹上一系列正确决策的加权和，并以 e 值序列作为关于正确性的统计证据来替代真值标签。我们的框架允许任意相互依赖的决策、依赖数据的轨迹终止、动态生成的假设，以及在轨迹结束后才定义的质量度量。我们构造了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需真值标签的智能体评估框架，将智能体质量定义为其轨迹中正确决策的加权和，用 e 值序列作为统计证据替代真值标签，并能处理任意相关的决策、数据依赖的轨迹终止以及动态生成的假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a ground-truth-free agent evaluation framework that defines agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of e-values as statistical evidence in place of ground-truth labels, while accommodating arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, and dynamically generated hypotheses.
